ruleDefinitions.name: Repository Addition Linux
ruleDefinitions.description: Linux Repository Addition / Package Source Change

sequences.query:
activity_type:"process_create"
AND
(
  (process_command_line:"add-apt-repository" AND process_command_line:"ppa:")
  OR
  (process_command_line:"/etc/apt/sources.list" AND (process_command_line:">>" OR process_command_line:"tee " OR process_command_line:"sed " OR process_command_line:"nano " OR process_command_line:"vim " OR process_command_line:"vi "))
  OR
  (process_command_line:"/etc/apt/sources.list.d/" AND (process_command_line:">>" OR process_command_line:"tee " OR process_command_line:"sed " OR process_command_line:"nano " OR process_command_line:"vim " OR process_command_line:"vi "))
  OR
  ((process_command_line:"yum-config-manager" OR process_command_line:"dnf config-manager") AND process_command_line:"--add-repo")
  OR
  (process_command_line:"/etc/yum.repos.d/" AND (process_command_line:">>" OR process_command_line:"tee " OR process_command_line:"sed " OR process_command_line:"nano " OR process_command_line:"vim " OR process_command_line:"vi "))
)
